# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

TaskFlow contributors, maintainers, and reviewers are expected to help keep this project respectful, constructive, and safe for collaboration.

This applies across issues, pull requests, code review, documentation, direct messages related to the project, and any public or private communication made in the context of TaskFlow work.

## Expected Behavior

- Communicate with respect, patience, and clarity
- Assume good intent while still giving honest technical feedback
- Keep discussions focused on the work, not the person
- Be especially thoughtful when helping newer contributors
- Raise concerns early instead of letting confusion grow

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, threats, or intimidation
- Discriminatory or exclusionary language
- Personal attacks, insults, or repeated hostile behavior
- Sharing private or sensitive information without permission
- Derailing conversations in a way that makes collaboration harder

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behavior that should be reviewed, report it privately to the maintainers through the contact path documented in the repository security or governance docs.

Please include:

- what happened
- where it happened
- links or screenshots if available
- whether immediate moderation is needed

Reports will be handled carefully and as privately as possible.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may take action they believe is necessary to protect the project and its contributors, including:

- asking for behavior changes
- removing content
- restricting participation
- blocking future participation when necessary

## Scope

This code of conduct applies in all TaskFlow repositories and their related collaboration spaces.
